summary: Split off MPI-365: the CivitAI v1 API has no licence field, so every flags-only verdict was reached without the field that governs. Also opens the ToS through-the-Service question for our R2 mirror. Fabio can DM creators for explicit permission.

Card updated with what the MPI-429 sweep already discharged, so the next session does not redo it. Badges were read for all 22 deps whose origin declares CivitAI/CivArchive (10 came back Apache-2.0 that the flags-only method had looking restrictive); the badge step is now mandatory in the klein Method; credit blocks for coyotte and S1LV3RC01N are in and verified rendering. Item 3 is DECIDED: badge-less CivitAI weights rest on CivitAI's Service-scoped default grant, which does not plainly authorise our own mirror, and the user judged that low practical risk and elected to ship as-is - a decision, not an oversight. The Krea 2 NSFW weight is SETTLED: it is coyotte's LUSTIFY V10 (CivitAI 573152), not the Comfy-Org weight the dep claimed until 2026-08-03; acquired legitimately via a paid subscription Fabio deliberately bought three months of to over-remunerate the creator, discussed with him directly; no outreach, ship as-is, credit on the About page. NEW SCOPE found while writing this up: the sweep selected on origin matching CivitAI, and NINE deps carry a bare community-merge filename as their origin (Juggernaut_XL, lustify_7, animemix_v80, ramthrustsNSFWPINK_alchemyMix176, animergemeij_v30VAE, four smoothMixWan22*), so they matched nothing and were never checked - and five of them ship inside released v1.0.1. Same root cause as MPI-429's qwen-lora-headswap gap: a weak origin field makes a weight invisible to any sweep. Resolve those by SHA256. Also still open: klein-style-chibi and klein-style-doodle remain badge-less on the bundle argument. Card stays in todo.

Card to doing to ship the R2-only decision for the Krea 2 NSFW weight. The user deleted krea2-raw-transformer-nsfw from Hugging Face: LUSTIFY V10 sits inside coyotte paid early-access until 2026-08-10, and a public HF repo redistributes it in a way our app-gated R2 does not. HF upload is DEFERRED to 2026-08-10, not cancelled. MPI-429 had re-hosted it, so the generic prefix rewrite was handing a blocked user an HF URL that 404s - HEAD-checked all 31 generic-rewrite mirrors and it was the only failure (30 x 302, 1 x 404). Fixed with noMirror true on the dep; transport-error-message suite 15/15 green and the re-run sweep reports 30 generic deps, no 404s. Recorded in docs/models/krea2/licences.md, docs/download-manager.md and .claude/rules/downloads.md, with the re-upload-and-remove-the-flag step dated in all three. Rest of the card is untouched: chibi and doodle badges, and the 9 weights whose origin is a bare merge filename.

Closed. The nine deps that carried a bare community-merge filename as their origin are resolved to six CivitAI models - Juggernaut XL by KandooAI, LUSTIFY by coyotte, animemix by koronen, RAMTHRUSTS-NSFW-PINK by RAMTHRUST, ANImergeMEij by reijlita, Smooth Mix Wan 2.2 by DigitalPastel - and NONE of the six carries a licence badge, so all fall under the Service-scoped default grant item 3 already decided. Five set allowNoCredit false, making attribution required for eight of the nine deps: credit blocks added and the credited-author count went 5 to 10, verified through the same _credits path MpiAbout renders. All nine origin values rewritten so a future sweep can see them. New doc docs/models/community-merges-licences.md, routed from docs/models/README.md. The method partly failed and the doc says so rather than hiding it: only wan-22-t2v-high and -low resolved by SHA256, the other seven match upstream on filename and size but not hash, so our copies are not byte-identical and provenance there is filename plus creator. Final decision by the user: KEEP all four weights that withhold the Image flag - ill-anime, pony-mix, klein-style-chibi, klein-style-doodle - and ship as-is. The chroma-style-cinema drop did not decide it because that was one LoRA in a renumberable rack while these are base checkpoints already in users hands in v1.0.1. chibi and doodle were re-checked the same day and are unchanged. Deliberately NOT carded: the seven hash mismatches, since no action follows from them. Residue belongs elsewhere - MPI-358 for the older cross-model credit sweep, MPI-433 for the Krea 2 NSFW re-upload after 2026-08-10.
